name: vesperaero-monorepo
description: VesperAero — Federated Climate-Action Platform for Hyper-local & Cross-border Pollution Monitoring

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CAPTURE,DASHBOARD" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:capture" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build:capture && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../apps/capture-client && npm install && cd ../gov-dashboard && npm install

author: Arun & Co
